meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

copy.tagline: 安装、发现和编排 HyperFrames 组件块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 HyperFrames 构建组合式前端应用
copy.tagline_en: Install, discover, and wire HyperFrames registry blocks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build composable frontend apps with HyperFrames

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 帮你使用 HyperFrames Registry：能安装现成的块（独立片段）或组件（效果片段），把它们接进你的项目文件，也能浏览目录、按标签搜索，还指导你制作并提交新模块。
howto.when: 当你说起要运行 hyperframes add 或 hyperframes catalog 命令、安装某个块或组件、把已安装的模块接进 index.html，或处理 hyperframes.json 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes add 安装 data-chart 这个块
say.note: 会安装并打印需要粘贴的接线代码。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes catalog 看看有哪些组件
say.note: 列出可安装的组件清单。

say.text: 把 grain-overlay 组件接进我的 index.html
say.note: 给出具体的接线步骤和属性设置。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude work with the HyperFrames Registry: install ready-made blocks or components, wire them into your project files, browse and search the catalog, and guide you through authoring and submitting new registry items.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to run hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, install a block or component, wire an installed item into index.html, or work with hyperframes.json.

say_en.text: Help me install the data-chart block with hyperframes add
say_en.note: Installs it and prints the wiring snippet to paste.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes catalog to see available components
Wire the grain-overlay component into my index.html
say_en.note: Shows the exact steps and attributes to set.
